overview: In South India, a psychiatrist discovers six young people planning to end their lives after facing fraud. He suggests a final trip to Goa, pretending to join them. But their journey turns deadly when theyre caught by a mafia using mobile radiation as a weapon. Trapped in a forest with kidnapped scientists, the group must fight to survive - and rediscover a reason to live. 6 Journey is a sharp, emotional thriller about hope in the darkest moments.
title: 6 Journey
